protocol.legacy100kPolicy: Run one bounded feasibility probe after the 1k/10k workload matrix and before 100k virtual trials; if censored, skip its remaining warmups/repetitions. If feasible, apply the same timeout bound to each legacy warmup/repetition and skip the remainder after any censor.
protocol.scrolling: Deterministic seeded random-access seeks; target indexes are identical between render modes for each size and repetition.
protocol.gc: Chromium CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage snapshots around each trial; HeapProfiler.collectGarbage before baseline and after removing the select and dropping benchmark data references.
protocol.percentileInterpretation: Event-level pooled scroll percentiles and the distribution of per-trial p95 values are reported separately. A per-trial p95 is not a cross-repetition percentile.
protocol.measurementType: Exploratory unless at least one warm-up and five measured repetitions are present for a feasible workload; no performance budget is enforced by this harness.

methodology.latencyQuantile: Nearest-rank empirical quantile; for five per-trial observations both p95 and p99 equal the maximum observation.
methodology.dispersion: Sample variance and sample standard deviation use n - 1; outlier flags use the 1.5×IQR Tukey fence with nearest-rank Q1/Q3. Flags are reported and never removed.
methodology.crossRunComparison: Runs remain separate because their GitHub runner image versions, kernels, and CPU models differ. No measurements are pooled across runs to estimate a single runner distribution.
methodology.interactionPooling: Random/sustained event observations are pooled only within one run and reported alongside the distribution of per-trial p50/p95/p99. Events within one trial are clustered, not independent repetitions.
methodology.warmups: One complete warm-up per feasible mode/size is recorded in the raw source report and excluded from all numeric estimates.
methodology.minimumSampleWarning: Five trials support a descriptive maximum and range, not a robust p95/p99 release SLO. Two independent hosted runner sessions are a small baseline, not a controlled variance study.

budgets.rationale: Both pinned runs are comfortably below the size-specific proposal. With five repetitions, nearest-rank p95 is the maximum observed trial, not a stable population-tail estimate.

nonBudgetMetrics.decision: Report only; the existing proposal has no numerical target for full render settlement. Do not substitute first-visible latency for this distinct endpoint.
Report each update and the frame-interval observations; the existing proposal defines no latency budget for this 10k synthetic monotonic scroll workload.

nonBudgetMetrics.proposedThreshold: Investigate repeated post-GC retained JavaScript heap above max(32 MiB, 25%) of baseline; not a pass/fail gate.
nonBudgetMetrics.decision: Do not infer a component leak from CDP heap deltas. These browser benchmark deltas include benchmark dataset/state and are distinct from the lifecycle-attribution object-retention investigation.

nonBudgetMetrics.proposedThreshold: Report intervals >33 ms and >50 ms; investigate when >50 ms exceeds 10%.
nonBudgetMetrics.decision: Report counts and denominator without a frame-rate guarantee or automatic failure.

hardCorrectnessInvariants: Seeded target indexes resolve to mounted options intersecting the scroll viewport.
End key sets the final active index and ARIA target to the final option.
Filtering returns the fixture-derived expected result count.
Test-only virtual-window mode remains within its existing 64-mounted-option ceiling.
releaseGateClassification.candidatePerformanceBudgets: All latency targets remain report-only until their measurement definitions, sample sizes, controlled runner protocol, and target approval are accepted.
releaseGateClassification.productionActivation: NO-GO; this evaluation does not authorize production defaults, APIs, runtime optimization, or public virtualization activation.
